insights:
Kimi K3, Kimi K3 (Max) and Kimi Latest all jumped from $3.97 to $6.77 per 1M tokens, a 71% hike, and DeepSeek Flash Latest rose from $0.347 to $0.608 (+75%). Z.ai's GLM 5.1 climbed 45%, $1.66 to $2.40, even as GLM Flash Latest fell 18% to $0.047.

Cuts concentrated at the cheap end. Meta's Llama 3.1 8B Instruct dropped from $0.060 to $0.027 (-56%), and all four Qwen3.8 27B variants (xhigh, low, medium, non-reasoning) fell from $0.967 to $0.443 (-54%). Qwen3.6 27B eased 6% to $1.20. PrismML's Ternary Bonsai 2 9B is new at $0.097 with no intelligence score yet.

Rankings moved sharply. GPT-6.1 Terra (max) climbed from #6 to #2, while GPT-6 Astra (max) gained 4 points to 57.0 and its high variant 4 points to 55.0. Against that, a broad band of scores dropped: MiMo-V2.6-Pro 46.0 to 30.0, Ling 3.1 Flash 1019 44.0 to 29.0 and #1 to #5, Grok 4.7 (xhigh) 46.0 to 34.0. Six models exited the top 10, including GLM-5.3 (max) and Mercury 2.5.
